Here, they have different dentists for each case: tooth extraction, specialization, root canal treatment, crowns, orthodontics. There are several dentists who rotate in caring for patients.

There's parking for two cars in front of the clinic. If it's full, you have to go 50 meters further to the Top Charoen eyewear store; there's a parking lot. If you get your parking ticket stamped by the clinic, it costs 20 baht for parking over an hour.

It was painless. However, his appointments are only on Sundays, making it very difficult to get an appointment.

Monday, January 22nd, 2024: Appointment with Dr. Mali for a follow-up appointment to proceed with the crown appointment. Two lower teeth including the post: 46,000 baht 😢

On Saturday, February 14th, 2026, I had a crown reattached on my front tooth that had come loose. The cement cost 2,500 baht, and the procedure cost 150 baht, totaling 2,650 baht. Done by Dr. Apinya.

I came here for a filling last time and the dentist was very gentle.

But this time it wasn't good at all. Filling an inner molar might be difficult, but this time the dentist was heavy-handed. I was also planning to get a tartar removal, just getting the filling done. While the dentist was working, the male nurse inserted the suction device almost right in the middle of my throat, nearly making me suffocate and vomit. I had to lift my hand. The dentist was startled and asked what was wrong. I told him he inserted it too deep. I couldn't explain properly, and he just kept telling me not to lift my hand, only reacting with surprise. Instead of helping by telling the nurse to be careful or asking more questions, he was too forceful.

Afterward, the dentist told me I could get the tartar removal whenever I wanted. I was confused and left the room feeling bewildered.

My boyfriend also had his tartar removed here, and he said the dentist was heavy-handed this time too.

The dentist should use more considerate and caring language.

We paid for the service. This isn't free service.

Filling 3 teeth: 1,650 baht.
My boyfriend got a scaling done: 1,650 baht.

That's strange, the prices are the same. Is it because we're using social security benefits?

Finally, cash only, no scanning. Credit cards incur a 3% surcharge.
